name: Ol'ga Mironova Dmitriyevna
source:
Born December 7th, 1962 in the city of Moscow. Spent most of her youth working part-time, due to being the only person capable of providing for her family. 

At the age of 28, entered into a marriage of convenience. Was subsequently brutally murdered by her husband while he was in a state of severe alcohol intoxication.

The widower, sentenced to 15 years in prison, justified his actions by claiming he suspected her of infidelity.

[Based on the in-game profile]
